note: Isle of Man is one of 'the Islands' (the Channel Islands and the Isle of Man), which the British Nationality Act 1981 counts as part of the United Kingdom (s. 50(1)), so its people are British citizens and the United Kingdom's rules on naturalisation and on keeping citizenship are theirs.

sources.title: legislation.gov.uk, British Nationality Act 1981, section 50 (Interpretation)
sources.said: the Islands ” means the Channel Islands and the Isle of Man; ... “ the United Kingdom ” means Great Britain, Northern Ireland and the Islands, taken together;
